correctness.rationale: Every threshold-three cross-color edge exists by diameter four. Girth eight enforces a unique common neighbor for each same-color clique, giving color factors equivalent to the incidence graph by contractible cone attachments and explicit elementary collapses. Their join is the stated three-sphere wedge. Join interchange has sign positive in bidegree (1,1); the positive invariant Casimir tensor survives every graph symmetry and hence the rational orbit quotient. Finite exact checker corroborates C8 and GQ(2,2) but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The all-graph structural theorem gives exact integral homotopy and natural full-symmetry integral homology modules for every finite generalized quadrangle and a larger class, without Desarguesian or group transitivity assumptions. Full-automorphism quotient nonvanishing is not implied by ordinary Betti numbers or the published natural-S6 special-case character. The motivating gap is classification of first post-girth-stability radius-three Rips spaces.
